structured.answer: The cheapest S&P 500 keren hishtalmut on this list is Clal (כלל), with a 0.48% management fee taken from the savings and nothing charged on new deposits. Menora Mivtachim is just behind at 0.49%. I would still check with my son or the bank before moving anything.

stuck.why: The list is sorted 'מהיקר לזול', so the most expensive (מור 0.7%) is at the top and I had to scroll to the bottom to find the cheapest
Fee shows 'עוד לא דווח' with an orange mark instead of a number, and it shows only 40% next to 'מניות'. I wasn't sure whether it counts, so I left it out
